content: Build merge_settings(defaults, overrides) for layered configuration. Return a new dict. Explicit empty strings clear inherited text, zero disables retries, and False disables a flag. Never mutate either input.
I considered value or defaults[key] as a short fallback expression.
That truthiness fallback is wrong: empty string, 0 and False are intentional overrides. Only None means inherit. A new key with None should be omitted because there is nothing to inherit.
I kept ordinary dict overlay as the starting point; it preserves explicit falsey values. None inheritance still needs an edit.
The public examples will cover theme changes. Keep the helper self-contained.
Normal theme replacement already works, and there are no imports.
Finish the pending inheritance change in settings.py and run the public smoke checks.
I will implement the None behavior in merge_settings.
